constraints.name: Rejected final words shadow sentence
constraints.description: In a 4x3 branch packet, read the final word of each unselected candidate in layer/candidate order; the words must match a declared sentence.

constraints.name: Readable surface with external branch apparatus
constraints.description: The draft surface contains selected path and shadow sentence, but the full residue lattice remains in an external branch packet.

constraints.name: Closed/open state switch
constraints.description: The selected path must render in a closed state and an open state whose appended words are selector-vector slices from the shadow sentence.

constraints.name: Selected-ending ergodic traversal
constraints.description: Selected line final-word lengths determine a route through omitted branch candidates, producing a traversal sentence and requiring reader/LLM work-path reconstruction.

constraints.name: Traversal words applied as patch operations
constraints.description: The traversal route words must authorize replacements against selected closed-state lines and produce a rendered patched surface.

constraints.claim: Every declared P0003 WAL draft validates as a database/sidecar pair without opening originals.
Current-facing validators resolve the active poem from STATE.current_head rather than hard-code P0002.
Each WAL successor uses an explicit draft spec and draft-specific artifact paths; historical pairs are not overwritten.
STATE status/summary aliases are identical and read_first contains current existing paths.
P0003-D003 remains same-turn unjudged; no D003 judgment may exist in rev0064.
D004 must render from relational state and a SQL view, with one explicit usual-residence UPDATE and no pre-rendered poem_lines table.
read_first/must_read, web pulse, risk/replay prose, nested current surfaces, and global-head ownership must agree with STATE.
P0003-D004 received no judgment in rev0065 and was reviewed only in later rev0066.
Every D004 user table must be snapshotted in full by tool-generated primary-key-ordered queries in both states.
P0003-D004 exact candidate bytes remain frozen; no D005 without concrete external-reader failure or project-owner line-level instruction.

constraints.claim: Preserve exact rev0068 D002 draft and OCI artifact bytes; do not create D003 without concrete external-reader failure or explicit owner instruction.
Before any generator write or descriptor blob I/O, canonicalize and prove spec-declared and digest-derived paths remain beneath their declared roots with no symlink components.

Manifesting, packaging, zip inspection, and manifest coverage must derive release membership and path safety from tools/release_tree.py; root do_rev*.py constructors are transient and forbidden in release zips.
